title: Derivative of the biased minus-probability polynomial
statement: Let $p\\in(0,1)$ and let $f$ be a function from $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{-1,1\\}$. The polynomial $Q_f(p)=(1-P_{f_{\\mathbb R}}(1-2p))/2$, where $f_{\\mathbb R}$ is the real-valued sign representation of $f$, is differentiable at $p$ with derivative $\\sigma(p)^{-1}\\sum_{i=1}^n\\widehat {f_{\\mathbb R}}_p(\\{i\\})$, where $\\sigma(p)=\\sqrt{4p(1-p)}$ and the coefficients are for the biased product measure with parameter $p$.
